response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS ov FROM budget GROUP BY category), avgn AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS a FROM cat) SELECT AVG(cat.ov) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(cat.n * 1.0) AS avg_line_count, AVG(cat.n - avgn.a) AS avg_excess_lines FROM cat, avgn WHERE cat.n > avgn.a
